title: Control (proposal)
description: Framework proposal; no open schema exists for a control. Attributes from Table 19.1 and components C4.2, C4.3, C4.4, C6.2 [10] [8] [18].

id.description: Persistent identifier, unique within the organization.

catalog_version.description: Catalog version the record was created under (C1.1; seventh principle: currency is a field).

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the record validates against.

version.description: Version of this record; rises on every change (nothing changes silently).

owner.description: Named owner (a person or role, never a function alone).

hierarchy_level.description: Level on the hierarchy of controls (C4.2) [10].

human_dependence.description: Degree to which the control depends on a person acting correctly.

expected_decay.description: Expected decay of effectiveness between tests (chapter 12).

frequency.description: How often the control operates or is run.

measured_effectiveness.description: Effectiveness as measured, not declared (fifth principle).

originating_response.description: Response (register row) that created the control (C4.1).

designer.description: Who designed the control, by name (twelve-month safeguard, C0.3, C6.2) [18].

assurer.description: Who assures it for the current year; must differ from the designer within twelve months of design.
